text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After much anticipation, the first round
of the
Unity Cup preseason has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm a li'l bit nervous,
but there's no need
to worry,
y'all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Our goal is to take down Team Zenith
with a
bang! So we can't go messin' up at
the first
hurdle, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's work together and have a race full
o' smiles!
